items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento (Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection)
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie on any storefront page. CISA added this vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including Stored XSS (CVE-2026-34686) and Path Traversal (CVE-2026-34653) that could lead to arbitrary code execution and arbitrary file system writes.

items.title: Openmage Magento RCE Vulnerability (Unrestricted File Upload)
items.summary: A critical unrestricted file upload vulnerability in OpenMage Magento LTS allows authenticated attackers to upload malicious PHP files and achieve remote code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: This critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique, with mass exploitation observed in the wild. Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 containing the fix, but older supported versions remain vulnerable.

items.title: Critical Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including server-side request forgery (CVE-2026-21293) and stored cross-site scripting (CVE-2026-21290), which could lead to privilege escalation and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Remote Code Execution vulnerability (CosmicSting)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows arbitrary code execution and has been exploited in the wild in limited attacks targeting Adobe Commerce merchants. Adobe has provided an isolated patch for this issue.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution and Customer Account Takeover (SessionReaper)
items.summary: This critical flaw allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions, with mass attacks observed shortly after its disclosure.
